fact: In August 2020 the director-general of civil identification said Semlex had issued over 900,000 of the 1,000,000 biometric ID documents contracted, with the national ID database still held by Semlex in Belgium.
title: SEMLEX EMITIU MAIS DE NOVECENTOS MIL BILHETES DE IDENTIDADE E TERMINA O CONTRATO SE ATINGIR UM MILHÃO DE REGISTOS
